method: conservative expansion of old keep mask using exposure-compensated temporal RGB variation >100 union over sampled episodes; 8px motion margin, lower workspace and left conveyor protection, 21px morphological closing, internal hole filling and removal of small blocked fragments
limitations: Sampled motion envelope is not semantic ground truth or an exhaustive all-frame guarantee. Fixed mask retains extra background to avoid clipping moving targets. No training performance evaluation.
validation: PNG/JSON identical; training RawImageMask applied on all sampled frames, preserved pixels identical and blocked pixels zero
